summary: Tested Email Quote (Microsoft Graph 365) feature end-to-end. Backend gating works correctly (status returns configured=false, send-quote returns 503 not 500). Frontend Email Quote modal renders from Preview toolbar with all required testids, prefills subject/body with est#+customer, shows the 'not enabled yet' banner, and disables the Send button. All 5 backend tests and all frontend assertions PASSED.

verified: toolbar-preview opens Preview modal; calculation completes
preview-pdf-email button visible in toolbar (next to Export/Print)
email-quote-to, email-quote-cc, email-quote-subject, email-quote-body all present and editable
Subject contains estNum (#RA-260615-082017) AND customer name (Jamestown Container Corp.)
Body contains quote # + customer + 'valid for 30 days' verbiage
email-quote-status banner shows: '⚠ Email sending isn't enabled yet — IT must grant Microsoft Graph Mail.Send consent...'
email-quote-send button is DISABLED (visually gray, disabled attr set)
Force-clicking Send does not close modal or trigger any API call
To field is editable (typed external_contact@customer.com successfully)

critical_code_review_comments: graph._creds() is called directly from routes/email.py (`graph._creds().get('mail_sender')`) — underscore-prefixed function is a private helper; consider exposing a public accessor like graph.mail_sender() for cleaner API boundary. Non-blocking.
EmailQuoteModal: when emailStatus() rejects (e.g. 401 on token expiry), the catch falls back to {configured: false} which correctly disables Send — good defensive default.
Subject template generates '... — Standard Printing Company' even when project is empty (project replacement is a no-op). Cosmetic only; output still valid.
send-quote endpoint correctly returns 503 (not 500) when GRAPH_MAIL_SENDER unset; auth is enforced via Depends(get_current_user).
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-existing quote RA-260615-082017 (Jamestown Container Corp.) already present in the admin's tabs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email Quote feature is intentionally gated until IT grants Mail.Send consent and sets GRAPH_MAIL_SENDER. When that env var is configured, re-test (a) /api/email/status → configured=true with sender populated, (b) /api/email/send-quote with valid payload → 200 {status:'sent'}, (c) frontend Send button becomes enabled and banner switches to the 'Sending from <sender>' style. Existing test file /app/backend/tests/test_email_quote.py can be extended with those positive-path cases.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Feature behaves exactly as designed for the not-yet-configured state.
